calls.prompt:
Company: Brightside Foods Co.

US mid-size packaged food company (~900 employees, plants in Ohio and Georgia). Makes hot dogs and sausages, brightly colored gummy candy, and pecan-and-apple snack bars. Buys pecans, apples and corn from US farms. Sells through grocery chains and convenience stores (many customers pay with SNAP / food stamps). Runs its own fleet of 40 delivery trucks. No restaurants, no alcohol, no exports.

Rules that APPLY:
- FDA food additive and color additive rules (dyes in candy, casings, meat)
- Food labeling and food safety rules for packaged food and meat products
- EPA pesticide residue limits on crops we buy (pecans, apples, corn)
- USDA marketing orders and grading for pecans and apples
- SNAP rules that change what shoppers can buy or who qualifies (affects demand)
- Workplace safety and labor rules for food plants; trucking safety rules for our fleet

Rules that DO NOT apply:
- Aviation, airspace, aircraft airworthiness
- Banking, securities, crypto, sanctions
- Medicare/Medicaid payment rules, medical devices
- Mining, offshore oil and gas, fisheries
- Broadcast/TV licensing

Affected areas and owners:
- food-safety: Additives, dyes, labeling, food safety → Maria Chen (Food Safety & Regulatory)
- sourcing: Ingredients from farms, pesticide limits, crop rules → Tom Alvarez (Sourcing)
- sales: Retail channels, SNAP, pricing → Aisha Grant (Sales Compliance)
- operations: Plant safety, labor, trucking fleet → Ben Kowalski (Operations)

Task: Find every US Federal Register document published between 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-13 (inclusive) that affects this company. For each, give the Federal Register document number, title, federalregister.gov URL, the key deadline, a tier (Critical if a deadline is < 90 days from 2026-11-13, otherwise High/Medium/Low by importance), the owner area, a one-line reason, and a one-line action. Only include items you found via search. Return an empty list if none.

Federal Register documents published between **2026-11-09** and **2026-11-13** (note: no Federal Register issue was published on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, due to the Veterans Day federal holiday) that affect **Brightside Foods Co.**:

---

### 1. `2026-22866` — Color Additive Petition From the International Association of Color Manufacturers; Request To Amend the Color Additive Regulations To Remove the Solvents Methylene Chloride, Trichloroethylene, and Ethylene Dichloride
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/10/2026-22866/color-additive-petition-from-the-international-association-of-color-manufacturers-request-to-amend`
* **Published:** 2026-11-10 (91 FR 72410)
* **Key Deadline:** **2026-12-10** (objections and hearing requests due); **2027-01-11** (effective date)
* **Tier:** **Critical** (both the 2026-12-10 objection deadline and 2027-01-11 effective date are < 90 days from 2026-11-13)
* **Owner Area:** `food-safety` → Maria Chen (Food Safety & Regulatory)
* **Reason:** FDA final order removing methylene chloride, trichloroethylene, and ethylene dichloride as authorized extraction solvents for annatto extract, paprika oleoresin, and turmeric oleoresin (21 CFR 73.30, 73.345, 73.615)—color additives commonly used in sausages/hot dogs and colored gummy candy.
* **Action:** Audit color additive supplier specifications and Certificates of Analysis for annatto, paprika, and turmeric colorants before January 11, 2027, to verify none use the revoked chlorinated solvents.

---

### 2. `2026-22865` — Color Additive Petition From Environmental Defense Fund et al.; Request To Amend the Color Additive Regulations To Remove the Solvents Ethylene Dichloride, Methylene Chloride, and Trichloroethylene
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/10/2026-22865/color-additive-petition-from-environmental-defense-fund-et-al-request-to-amend-the-color-additive`
* **Published:** 2026-11-10 (91 FR 72413)
* **Key Deadline:** **2026-12-10** (objections and hearing requests due); **2027-01-11** (effective date)
* **Tier:** **Critical** (both the 2026-12-10 objection deadline and 2027-01-11 effective date are < 90 days from 2026-11-13)
* **Owner Area:** `food-safety` → Maria Chen (Food Safety & Regulatory)
* **Reason:** FDA final order revoking authorization for methylene chloride as a diluent in color additive mixtures for inks used in marking fruits and vegetables (21 CFR 73.1) under the Delaney Clause, affecting incoming whole apples bought from US farms.
* **Action:** Coordinate with Sourcing to confirm before January 11, 2027, that US apple suppliers do not use fruit-marking inks formulated with methylene chloride diluents.

---

### 3. `2026-23112` — Revocation of the Color Additive Listing for Use of Orange B on Casings or Surfaces of Frankfurters and Sausages; Confirmation of Effective Date
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/13/2026-23112/revocation-of-the-color-additive-listing-for-use-of-orange-b-on-casings-or-surfaces-of-frankfurters`
* **Published:** 2026-11-13 (91 FR 73139)
* **Key Deadline:** None upcoming (confirms **2026-09-08** past effective date with no objections received)
* **Tier:** **High** (no future deadline < 90 days, but directly governs color additives on hot dog and sausage casings)
* **Owner Area:** `food-safety` → Maria Chen (Food Safety & Regulatory)
* **Reason:** Formally confirms the repeal of 21 CFR 74.250, permanently prohibiting the use of Orange B to color the casings or surfaces of frankfurters and sausages.
* **Action:** Document final confirmation in regulatory compliance records and verify that all hot dog and sausage casing specifications remain free of Orange B.

---

### 4. `2026-22826` — Pecans Grown in the States of Alabama, Arkansas, Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, Kansas, Louisiana, Missouri, Mississippi, North Carolina, New Mexico, Oklahoma, South Carolina, and Texas; Changes to Membership and Handling Requirements
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-22826`
* **Published:** 2026-11-09 (91 FR 70809)
* **Key Deadline:** **2026-12-09** (public comments due)
* **Tier:** **Critical** (deadline is 26 days from 2026-11-13)
* **Owner Area:** `sourcing` → Tom Alvarez (Sourcing)
* **Reason:** USDA AMS proposed rule under the federal pecan marketing order (7 CFR Part 986, which covers Georgia and 14 other states) modifying sheller membership rules, inter-handler transfer reporting, and adding a 5% late fee plus 1% monthly interest on unpaid assessments.
* **Action:** Check whether our Georgia plant's farm-direct pecan purchases trigger "handler" reporting/assessment rules under 7 CFR Part 986 and submit any comments with pecan suppliers by December 9, 2026.

---

### 5. `2026-22769` — Pesticides; Notice of Receipt of Requests to Voluntarily Cancel Certain Pesticide Registrations and/or Amend Registrations To Terminate Certain Uses With a 30-Day Comment Period (June 2026)
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/09/2026-22769/pesticides-notice-of-receipt-of-requests-to-voluntarily-cancel-certain-pesticide-registrations-andor`
* **Published:** 2026-11-09 (91 FR 70881)
* **Key Deadline:** **2026-12-09** (comments and withdrawal requests due)
* **Tier:** **Critical** (deadline is 26 days from 2026-11-13)
* **Owner Area:** `sourcing` → Tom Alvarez (Sourcing)
* **Reason:** EPA notice proposing to terminate "bearing apple" orchard crop uses on multiple oxamyl pesticide registrations (EPA Reg. Nos. 81598-16 and 81598-17), affecting crop protection practices and future residue compliance for US apples we buy.
* **Action:** Alert US apple growers/suppliers of the pending termination of bearing-apple oxamyl uses and submit any supply-impact comments to EPA by December 9, 2026.

---

### 6. `2026-22810` — Pioneer Hi-Bred International, Inc.; Determination of Nonregulated Status and Draft Plant Pest Risk Assessment for Insect Resistant COR-ØØ121-4 Maize (Zea mays)
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-22810`
* **Published:** 2026-11-09 (91 FR 70834)
* **Key Deadline:** **2027-01-08** (public comments due)
* **Tier:** **Critical** (deadline is 56 days from 2026-11-13)
* **Owner Area:** `sourcing` → Tom Alvarez (Sourcing)
* **Reason:** USDA APHIS notice seeking comment on deregulating genetically engineered insect-resistant COR-ØØ121-4 corn, affecting US farm corn varieties entering the domestic supply chain and bioengineered food labeling tracking.
* **Action:** Review corn sourcing specifications (e.g., non-GMO vs. bioengineered disclosure requirements) with Food Safety & Regulatory and file any comments by January 8, 2027.

---

### 7. `2026-22936` — Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Reforming Categorical Eligibility
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/10/2026-22936/supplemental-nutrition-assistance-program-reforming-categorical-eligibility`
* **Published:** 2026-11-10 (91 FR 72454)
* **Key Deadline:** **2026-12-10** (written comments due)
* **Tier:** **Critical** (deadline is 27 days from 2026-11-13)
* **Owner Area:** `sales` → Aisha Grant (Sales Compliance)
* **Reason:** USDA proposed rule restricting broad-based TANF categorical eligibility for SNAP (projected by USDA to remove ~6.3 million people / $44.65B in SNAP benefits), directly reducing grocery and convenience store demand from SNAP-paying shoppers.
* **Action:** Model regional SNAP sales exposure across grocery and convenience store accounts and submit retail/food-manufacturer comments (directly or via trade associations) by December 10, 2026.

---

### 8. `2026-22944` — Modification to Work Requirements for Able-Bodied Adults
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/10/2026-22944/modification-to-work-requirements-for-able-bodied-adults`
* **Published:** 2026-11-10 (91 FR 72439)
* **Key Deadline:** **2026-12-10** (written comments due)
* **Tier:** **Critical** (deadline is 27 days from 2026-11-13)
* **Owner Area:** `sales` → Aisha Grant (Sales Compliance)
* **Reason:** USDA proposed rule tightening SNAP 3-month time limits, exceptions, and area waiver criteria for able-bodied adults (7 CFR Parts 271 & 273), further reducing SNAP household qualification and demand in grocery and convenience channels.
* **Action:** Assess demand impact alongside `2026-22936` for SNAP-heavy retail channels and submit any public comments by December 10, 2026.

---

### 9. `2026-22761` — Rules of Practice and Procedure for Administrative Hearings Before the Office of Administrative Law Judges
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/11/09/2026-22761/rules-of-practice-and-procedure-for-administrative-hearings-before-the-office-of-administrative-law`
* **Published:** 2026-11-09 (91 FR 70790)
* **Key Deadline:** **2026-12-09** (effective date)
* **Tier:** **Critical** (deadline is 26 days from 2026-11-13)
* **Owner Area:** `operations` → Ben Kowalski (Operations)
* **Reason:** DOL final rule amending 29 CFR Part 18 to mandate electronic filing and electronic service (`eFile/eServe`) for represented employers in DOL administrative proceedings (covering whistleblower/retaliation, Surface Transportation Assistance Act trucking safety complaints, and wage/labor disputes).
* **Action:** Notify HR and outside labor/employment counsel to ensure active DOL `eFile/eServe` accounts and e-service workflows are ready before December 9, 2026.

---

### 10. `2026-22814` — Agency Information Collection Activities: Requests for Comments; Clearance of a Renewed Approval of Information Collection(s): Procedures for Transportation Workplace Drug and Alcohol Testing Programs (ICR 2105-0529)
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-22814` (Docket `DOT-OST-2026-4192`)
* **Published:** 2026-11-09 (91 FR 70985)
* **Key Deadline:** **2027-01-08** (comments due)
* **Tier:** **Critical** (deadline is 56 days from 2026-11-13)
* **Owner Area:** `operations` → Ben Kowalski (Operations)
* **Reason:** DOT notice renewing mandatory 49 CFR Part 40 drug and alcohol testing recordkeeping and reporting forms (DOT F 1380 Alcohol Testing Form and DOT F 1385 MIS Data Collection Form) required for CDL drivers operating our 40-truck fleet.
* **Action:** Review current DOT Part 40 drug/alcohol testing recordkeeping with our fleet compliance team/TPA and submit any comments on administrative burden by January 8, 2027.

---

### 11. `2026-22903` — Federal-State Unemployment Compensation Program; Establishing a National Minimum Weekly Work Search Requirement
* **URL:** `https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-22903`
* **Published:** 2026-11-10
* **Key Deadline:** **2027-01-11** (public comments due)
* **Tier:** **Critical** (deadline is 59 days from 2026-11-13)
* **Owner Area:** `operations` → Ben Kowalski (Operations)
* **Reason:** DOL Employment and Training Administration proposed rule amending 20 CFR Part 604 to mandate a minimum of five weekly work-search activities for unemployment compensation claimants, affecting UI claim administration and labor pool dynamics at our Ohio and Georgia plants.
* **Action:** Have HR review the proposed Unemployment Insurance work-search verification rules for impact on Ohio and Georgia plant workforce administration and submit any comments by January 11, 2027.

items.reason: EPA notice proposing to terminate "bearing apple" orchard crop uses on multiple oxamyl pesticide registrations (EPA Reg. Nos. 81598-16 and 81598-17), affecting crop protection practices and future residue compliance for US apples we buy.
items.action: Alert US apple growers/suppliers of the pending termination of bearing-apple oxamyl uses and submit any supply-impact comments to EPA by December 9, 2026.

items.title: Pioneer Hi-Bred International, Inc.; Determination of Nonregulated Status and Draft Plant Pest Risk Assessment for Insect Resistant COR-ØØ121-4 Maize (Zea mays)
items.reason: USDA APHIS notice seeking comment on deregulating genetically engineered insect-resistant COR-ØØ121-4 corn, affecting US farm corn varieties entering the domestic supply chain and bioengineered food labeling tracking.
items.action: Review corn sourcing specifications (e.g., non-GMO vs. bioengineered disclosure requirements) with Food Safety & Regulatory and file any comments by January 8, 2027.

items.title: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Reforming Categorical Eligibility
items.reason: USDA proposed rule restricting broad-based TANF categorical eligibility for SNAP (projected by USDA to remove ~6.3 million people / $44.65B in SNAP benefits), directly reducing grocery and convenience store demand from SNAP-paying shoppers.
items.action: Model regional SNAP sales exposure across grocery and convenience store accounts and submit retail/food-manufacturer comments (directly or via trade associations) by December 10, 2026.

items.title: Modification to Work Requirements for Able-Bodied Adults
items.reason: USDA proposed rule tightening SNAP 3-month time limits, exceptions, and area waiver criteria for able-bodied adults (7 CFR Parts 271 & 273), further reducing SNAP household qualification and demand in grocery and convenience channels.
items.action: Assess demand impact alongside 2026-22936 for SNAP-heavy retail channels and submit any public comments by December 10, 2026.

items.title: Rules of Practice and Procedure for Administrative Hearings Before the Office of Administrative Law Judges
items.reason: DOL final rule amending 29 CFR Part 18 to mandate electronic filing and electronic service (eFile/eServe) for represented employers in DOL administrative proceedings (covering whistleblower/retaliation, Surface Transportation Assistance Act trucking safety complaints, and wage/labor disputes).

items.title: Agency Information Collection Activities: Requests for Comments; Clearance of a Renewed Approval of Information Collection(s): Procedures for Transportation Workplace Drug and Alcohol Testing Programs (ICR 2105-0529)

items.title: Federal-State Unemployment Compensation Program; Establishing a National Minimum Weekly Work Search Requirement
